title: Blue Palmetto Vacation Rental
meta_description: Blue Palmetto is a 5.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description Blue Palmetto is a spacious five-bedroom Grayton Beach retreat designed for laid-back yet elevated coastal living. With a private pool, private elevator, and complimentary 6-Passenger Electric Cart, this home comfortably welcomes up to fifteen guests across multiple living spaces, making it an excellent fit for multifamily and multigenerational stays. Set between the Gulf of Mexico and the natural beauty of Western Lake, Blue Palmetto pairs relaxed interiors with generous outdoor spaces and an easy, walkable location. Guests can spend the day by the private pool and waterfall, gather on the screened porch, or take the electric cart to explore Grayton Beach, Seaside, and other 30A favorites. As with every Sanders Beach Rentals property, stays here are supported by thoughtful details, reliable service, and a focus on comfort and ease.Property Highlights Complimentary 6-Passenger Electric Cart Parking for Up to 6 Vehicles Pet Friendly (Additional Fee Applies) Private Elevator 28’ x 12’ Private Pool With Cascading Waterfall (Complimentary Pool Heating Available October 1 to May 1) Pool Patio With Lounge Chairs, Fire Pit, and Shuffleboard Poolside Cabana With Outdoor Shower and Changing Area Gas Grill for Easy Poolside Cookouts Two Separate Living Spaces, Including a Lofted Bonus Den Expansive Screened Porch Ideal for Morning Coffee or Evening Cocktails Fully Equipped Kitchen With Commercial-Style Gas Range and Double Ovens 2-Minute Walk to the Sugar White Sand of Grayton Beach 4-Minute Electric Cart Ride to The Red Bar 8-Minute Electric Cart Ride to Seaside Experience the Home Arrival at Blue Palmetto is straightforward and relaxed, with covered parking leading directly to the private outdoor area. The 28’ x 12’ pool with a cascading waterfall anchors the space, surrounded by lounge chairs that invite slow afternoons in the sun. A fire pit and shuffleboard court add easy entertainment, while the poolside cabana with an outdoor shower and changing area keeps beach days organized and convenient. From this level, the private elevator carries guests and luggage to the main living and bedroom floors, making transitions simple for every member of the group. On the main living level, vaulted ceilings and warm wood accents create an inviting coastal atmosphere. The living room offers comfortable seating and a wall-mounted TV, providing a natural hub for movie nights or catching up after time at the beach. Nearby, the dining area centers around a large wooden table that works as well for shared meals as it does for card games and puzzles. The kitchen is fully equipped for cooking for a crowd, with a commercial-style gas range, double ovens, and ample counter space. Whether guests are preparing a quick breakfast before heading out or a full holiday dinner, this space is built to handle it with ease. Just beyond, an expansive screened porch extends the living area outdoors. It becomes a favorite spot throughout the day, from quiet coffee in the morning to reading in the afternoon and unwinding in the evening breeze. This level also holds three well-planned bedrooms. The Primary Bedroom includes a king bed and twin bed, along with an ensuite bath that offers two walk-in showers, a soaking tub, and a double vanity with dressing area. A second bedroom provides a king bed with an ensuite bathroom with a tub and shower combination. The bunk room, with a queen-over-queen setup, has easy access to the nearby hall bathroom with a tub and shower combination. A full laundry room on this floor keeps swimsuits, beach towels, and everyday clothing in easy rotation. The third floor is anchored by a lofted bonus den that functions as a second living space, particularly convenient for kids, teens, or a separate group wanting their own area to relax. Equipped with a sofa, TV, and tabletop foosball, it gives guests a casual place to spread out after a day on the water. Two additional guest bedrooms share a Jack-and-Jill bath with a walk-in shower and double vanity. Each bedroom includes a king bed and twin bed, creating flexible sleeping arrangements that suit a variety of family and friend groups. Throughout the home, the layout supports togetherness in the main gathering areas while still providing plenty of private spaces to rest and recharge.Sleeping Arrangements First Floor Covered Parking Private Pool Shuffleboard Court Poolside Cabana With Shower and Changing Area Private Elevator Access to Upper Levels Second Floor Living Room With Balcony Access Kitchen and Dining Area Primary Bedroom: King Bed and Twin Bed (Sleeps 3), Ensuite Bathroom With Two Walk-In Showers and Soaking Tub King Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Ensuite Bathroom With Tub and Shower Combination Bunk Room: Queen-Over-Queen Bunk (Sleeps 4), Shared Hall Bathroom With Tub and Shower Combination Laundry Room Third Floor Lofted Bonus Den With TV and Tabletop Foosball Guest Bedroom: King Bed and Twin Bed (Sleeps 3), Shared Jack-and-Jill Bathroom With Walk-In Shower Guest Bedroom: King Bed and Twin Bed (Sleeps 3), Shared Jack-and-Jill Bathroom With Walk-In Shower Life in Grayton Beach Blue Palmetto is located in historic Grayton Beach, one of 30A’s most character-filled coastal communities. Guests are just a short walk from the shoreline and an easy electric cart ride from local favorites such as The Red Bar, Zoo Gallery, Western Lake, and Grayton Beach State Park. Seaside and other nearby beach communities are only minutes away, offering additional dining, shopping, and family-friendly activities. The home combines the charm and history of Grayton Beach with the comfort and attentive service guests expect from Sanders Beach Rentals.
